summary: Created tests/TestSuites/DOM/DOMSelectorExceptionTests.php with 10 tests covering: exception constructor, getSelector(), getHTML(), code, previous, DOMHelper throwing DOMSelectorException with correct selector/HTML/message.

Fixed DOMSelectorException::__construct() parent call: was parent::__construct($message, $code, $previous); corrected to parent::__construct($message, null, $code, $previous) to match BaseException signature (string, ?string, ?int, ?Throwable).
14/14 tests pass. storage/debug/ absent (no debug files created by tests). Scenario 2 confirmed. Scenario 3 verified by code review.

comments.note: Bug found during WP-004 testing: DOMSelectorException::__construct() was calling parent::__construct($message, $code, $previous), but BaseException expects (string $message, ?string $details, ?int $code, ?Throwable $previous). Fix applied: parent::__construct($message, null, $code, $previous). This did not affect the 4 original tests since they never instantiated DOMSelectorException.

Scenario 3 (AJAX JSON propagation) requires a running web server and cannot be exercised via PHPUnit. Verified by code review: BasePage::handleAJAX() catches Throwable and calls sendAJAXError($e->getMessage()). The re-thrown WebcomicsBuilderException message includes the debug path, so the JSON message will contain it. No structural AJAX changes were made.
